description: VCF: every Surge XT filter model and subtype in one polyphonic stereo filter

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, marked in volts; 0V is middle C at 261.63Hz. There is no V/Oct jack, so to track a keyboard patch it into a modulation input and set that depth to 1.
Sets the resonance of the filter.
Sets the gain into the filter, which changes how hard the non-linear filter models are driven.
Blends between the unfiltered input and the filter output.
Sets the gain applied after the filter.
Modulation depth into the filter frequency, in octaves per volt; at 1 the modulation input tracks 1V per octave, which makes the filter follow a keyboard.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.
Chooses the filter model; the display draws the response of a chirp swept through the filter as it is set.
Chooses the subtype of the filter model, which can change its behaviour a great deal.

inputs.text: The left channel of the signal to be filtered.
The right channel of the signal to be filtered; leave it unpatched to run the filter in mono.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

notes: The filter type and its subtype are chosen from the two named settings in the display area; clicking one opens its list of choices, and dragging it moves through that list.
A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Curve Poly Channel — a submenu choosing which polyphonic channel the response curve is drawn for, Ch 1 to Ch 16.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
